description: An HTML file demonstrating event propagation and dynamic creation of Canvas widgets using the SmartClient framework, including click event handling and widget hierarchy setup.

methods.name: Page.setEvent
methods.description: Sets a global event handler for page events, such as click, with a confirmation dialog.

methods.name: Canvas.create
methods.description: Creates a Canvas widget with specified properties, used here to build a widget hierarchy.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child widget to a parent widget, establishing a widget hierarchy.
